facts.fact: Founded 1899 as the Franklin Rod and Gun Club; golf came in the early 1920s.

current.subject: A turtle walking, domed shell over a gold rim (developer's pick).
current.keep: The turtle and its gold rim.
current.weaknesses: Side-on, the shell pattern is lost.

concepts.name: The Turtle, from Above
concepts.rationale: Seen from directly above, as the game sees the course: hexagonal scutes, gold rim, legs and head out.
concepts.typography: Libre Franklin Bold, for the name.
concepts.strengths: A crisp geometric emblem; reads at 1x.
concepts.tradeoffs: The turtle has no documented link to the club.

concepts.name: The Rod and Gun Fly
concepts.rationale: A classic dry fly on its hook: white wings, brown hackle, a red band. The club began as a fishing and shooting club.
concepts.symbolism: The sporting club it was before it was a golf club.
concepts.interpretation: The fly is a generic classic pattern, not one tied to the club.
concepts.tradeoffs: Fishing imagery may confuse at a glance.

recommendation: Concept 1. The top-down turtle is one of the strongest icons in the set; the fly is the better heritage story.
